remaining_role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let Operating and Value reconsider only their independently rejected contribution, cohort and product-economics propositions.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One immutable role workpaper, role-local repair context, finding receipts and unchanged authority sets per unfinished role.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: One substantive revised natural draft for Operating and one for Value without invented facts, relations or sources.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: Repair context carries prior judgment, affected surfaces and immutable Evidence, NumericFact, Relation and gap references.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Very high because expense contribution, same-quarter cohort conversion and product pricing-power semantics affect financial truth.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R7 completed Cash, Counterevidence and Demand analyses at 32000 tokens; R8 spent only one strict Demand submission and never called Operating or Value.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for genuine role-local financial reconsideration.
remaining_role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One draft per unfinished role and zero retry; any failure preserves R7, R8 and the zero-call Demand authority-ceiling successor.

remaining_role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map only the new Operating and Value natural drafts into strict workpapers while keeping every authority set unchanged.
remaining_role_repair_submission.input_scale: Two role-local drafts plus compact submission views, finding receipts, schema rules and locked reference authority.
remaining_role_repair_submission.required_outputs: Two valid repaired workpapers whose contribution, cohort and product-economics statements obey the repaired semantic boundaries.
remaining_role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested thesis, claims, mechanism, alternatives, counterarguments, gaps and change conditions remain role-local and ref-bound.
remaining_role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error can erase a natural correction or smuggle authority, so local validation and exact reference comparison remain mandatory.
remaining_role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R7 Cash and Counterevidence strict submissions passed; R7 and R8 Demand exposed the one unbound-authority pattern now closed locally without a new call.
remaining_role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 because the financial analysis is already present in each role draft.
remaining_role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call per unfinished submission and zero retry; invalid JSON, new authority or truncation fails closed and consumes the attempt.

lead_recheck_analysis.node_purpose: Compare the five repaired workpapers with unchanged Supply before independent reassessment.
lead_recheck_analysis.input_scale: Six validated workpapers after seven bound findings, including a receipt-visible Demand authority ceiling and no new evidence.
lead_recheck_analysis.required_outputs: One materiality-ranked Lead draft that proceeds or identifies only a catalog-bound unresolved challenge.
lead_recheck_analysis.schema_burden: Lead may select only challenges compiled from the six current workpapers and cannot author facts, references or repairs.
lead_recheck_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: A false proceed can repeat R5 semantic failure while an unbounded loop would overfit the workflow and spend unjustified calls.
lead_recheck_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead completed naturally but missed seven errors; R7 and R8 did not reach the Lead frontier.
lead_recheck_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking=max with max_tokens 32000 for cross-role financial comparison.
lead_recheck_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural Lead draft and zero retry; off-catalog, incomplete or truncated output preserves the exact frontier.

lead_recheck_submission.node_purpose: Map the Lead recheck into the strict catalog-bound decision without changing its routing judgment.
lead_recheck_submission.input_scale: One Lead draft plus a deterministic challenge catalog derived from the six post-repair workpapers.
lead_recheck_submission.required_outputs: One valid accepted and deferred challenge partition, rationale and next state consistent with unresolved work.
lead_recheck_submission.schema_burden: Identifiers must be unique catalog members and next state must match the accepted and deferred challenge partition.
lead_recheck_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapper error could falsely unlock independent evaluation or Writer, so invalid decisions remain terminal.
lead_recheck_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R5 Lead strict submission succeeded with this profile; no content-repair Lead call has yet been attempted.
lead_recheck_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro GA thinking disabled with max_tokens 8000 for strict mapping only.
lead_recheck_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One Tool Call and zero retry; invalid identifiers, inconsistent state or truncation fails closed.

known_boundary: This exact-once R9 authority preserves immutable R5, the consumed R7 six-call terminal and the consumed R8 one-call terminal. It locally revalidates only the precise gap-backed Demand claim digest under a not_inferable ceiling without changing claim text, Evidence, NumericFact, Relation or gap refs. It permits only Operating and Value analysis plus strict submission pairs and one Lead recheck pair, at most six new Provider calls and zero retry, fallback, S1/S2 request, retrieval, external source call, Candidate promotion, product-pointer mutation or Writer work. Any failure consumes this authority and all output identities. Contract success still requires independent L1/L2 and content reassessment and does not authorize Writer, S3 acceptance, heterogeneous generalization, Workbench publication or release.
